thread:
maria-support: Hey @jordan-sales — heads up: AcmeCorp (POC) hit hard 429s during a live demo 20m ago. They're on the free sandbox key and say the demo is in 30m. Can we do a temporary quota advisory or sales-assisted bump? :grimacing:

jordan-sales: Thanks, Maria. Can you paste the org_id and the request IDs? I can flag for a short exception if we have the details. Need to know if it's concurrent keys or one client hammering.

maria-support: Org: org_acme_924. Customer supplied one sample request id: req_8f3c9b. They said they were running repeated embeddings and a few long-generation chat calls.

sahil-eng: Quick check — free sandbox plans have a concurrency+throughput soft cap. If they hit token/sec limits we'll 429. Do we have the exact response headers from the call (x-rw-rl-limit, x-rw-rl-remaining)?

maria-support: They sent this snippet from their client logs: ```HTTP/1.1 429 Too Many Requests
Content-Type: application/json
{"error":"rate_limit_exceeded","retry_after":12}``` No rate headers included. Their infra team is a bit muddy about parallel keys.

ops-oncall: If there's no rate headers, likely the request path hit a global per-key burst guard. We can do a 2-hour temporary increase but need to rotate key afterward and collect traffic pattern. Jordan — want to offer a 2hr sandbox bump to 5x concurrency?

jordan-sales: Sounds good as short-term. Maria, confirm they accept key rotation and a handshake call after the demo. Also share pricing/upgrade link for paid tier that gives guaranteed reserved throughput. I can prepare a one-off promo if they convert within 14 days.

maria-support: Customer said yes to rotation. They prefer not to rotate mid-demo though. Ask: can we do a safer approach — a scoped exception tied to that single api_key for 2 hours, then auto-revoke?

sahil-eng: We can create a temporary allowance flag on the key (internal tool) scoped to org_acme_924 and expire it. I need the key suffix (last 6 chars) and the exact start window. Also recommend they reduce batch_size for embeddings to avoid KV/cache pressure.

maria-support: Key suffix: ****-a1b2c3. Demo starts at 17:10 UTC (in ~18m). Please create exception from 17:05–19:05 UTC. Also sending this snippet to customer for quick client tweak: ```curl -X POST https://api.redwood.com/v1/chat \ -H "Authorization: Bearer $API_KEY" \ -H "Content-Type: application/json" \ -d '{"model":"rwd-chat-large","messages":[{"role":"user","content":"..."}],"max_tokens":256}'``` Suggest lower max_tokens to 128 for demo.

quota-bot: [automated] Received exception request for org_acme_924. Ticket #SUP-9112 created. Expires in 120 minutes unless earlier revoked.

ops-oncall: Exception flagged and scheduled. Note: we'll log a postmortem if their call patterns indicate abusive rewind (extreme parallelism).

jordan-sales: I'll draft the promo email and schedule a short customer onboarding call post-demo. Maria, please cc me on the support email thread so I can handle conversion.

sahil-eng: Also recommend they switch to a paid plan for predictable headroom — docs: https://docs.redwood.com/plans#dedicated-throughput — and enable token-level cost view so they can see hot paths.

maria-support: Sending confirmation to the customer now. Will update thread with the outcome after demo. Thanks team :thumbsup:

maria-support: Update (after demo): customer completed demo successfully, saw no 429s during window. They accepted a post-demo key rotation and agreed to the follow-up call. Closing temporary exception.

jordan-sales: Awesome — I'll reach out for conversion. Please attach request logs to SUP-9112 for the onboarding call.

ops-oncall: Marking incident as resolved; keep an eye for subsequent spikes. If they request persistent higher throughput we'll propose Dedicated or Reserved capacity options.

maria-support: Closing thread.
